payload.reason: The evidence specifies the use of deep learning architectures for sentence segmentation, particularly mentioning models like T-LSTM and Bi-LSTM-CRF.

claims.text: The proposed deep learning model for Thai sentence segmentation integrates n-gram embedding and self-attention modules.
The Bi-LSTM-CRF model is adopted as a baseline for sentence segmentation tasks.
T-LSTM and a bidirectional LSTM model with attention (T-BRNN) are mentioned as deep learning approaches for sequence tagging.
